Commentary.Commentary: So that's it from us for this game. India have opened their account  in the series. They will now head to Antigua for the third game where the hosts will try to put in a strong performance unlike this match. The third ODI begins on 30th June at 0900 local (1300 GMT). Join us for it. Until then, goodbye and take care!

Man of the Match, Ajinkya Rahane says that he is really happy with the way he batted. Mentions that he was hungry for runs as he did not get an opportunity in the Champions Trophy. Informs that he enjoys batting with Shikhar Dhawan as they compliment each other really well. Reckons that they only tried to play normal cricket initially which worked well for them.

India skipper, Virat Kohli calls it a complete performance. Admits the partnership between Ajinkya Rahane and Shikhar Dhawan was very good. Credits Bhuvneshwar Kumar and Kuldeep Yadav for the way they bowled. Appreciates Rahane for his mental strength and the character he possesses. Mentions that he would prefer scoring runs for his team rather than thinking about personal accolades. Says they will regroup and think about the changes which can be made for the upcoming games.

West Indies skipper, Jason Holder says that they did not bowl well. Reckons that the momentum never went their way. Credits Ajinkya Rahane and Shikhar Dhawan for the way they batted. Mentions that they might make some changes in the next game. Informs that not everything is lost and they will hope to put in a better performance in Antigua. Applauds Shai Hope for his brilliant knock and also acknowledges the performance of Roston Chase.

During the chase the Windies batsmen never looked comfortable in the middle. They were jolted quite early with twin blows from Bhuvneshwar Kumar. Shai Hope and Evin Lewis gave some fight. The former scored a half-century which was the only highlight for them. The Men in Blue kept bowling tight lines and lengths and hardly gave anything away. Kuldeep Yadav bowled exceptionally well and bagged three wickets in the process. India completed their biggest win against West Indies, in West Indies with some ease.

A massive victory for India, they totally outplayed their opponent in all the three departments. Apart from winning the toss, the hosts hardly got anything right. They asked India to bat and the visitors responded in some style. They posted a total over the 300-run mark on the back of some fantastic batting performances by their top-order. Shikhar Dhawan, Virat Kohli and Ajinkya Rahane were ruthless and hardly faced any problems against the West Indian bowling attack.
